2d_tool.spec: પડાવ-પટ્ટી — a horizontal route strip of the writer's own journey inside this chapter, placed on the closing topic so the child walks the essay back before writing their own. Four cards, in the text's own order, each labelled only with words the chapter prints: 'જેસલમેરનો કિલ્લો', 'ઝરૂખા ને પટવાઓની હવેલીઓ', 'રેતીના ઢૂવા', 'બીજા દિવસની સવારનો પરિવેશ'. WHAT THE CHILD MANIPULATES: (a) tapping a card opens it; (b) a shuffle button scatters the four cards and the child drags them back into the order the writer moved.
